storyCards.headline: Green Eyed Lady: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Sugarloaf's "Green Eyed Lady" reached #3 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #3 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 17 weeks on the chart.

Green Eyed Lady was released in 1970.

Chart story — peaked at #3 on the Hot 100.
